courses.title: Sacred Dance for Freedom
courses.description: A seven-module recorded course, about ten and a half hours long, in which Banafsheh teaches whirling, shaking and other Dance of Oneness rituals as a way of living from love and joy. Students keep lifelong access to the recordings and bonus material.

left_out: Shift Network versions of her courses: theshiftnetwork.com is never fetched.
flags: The course page says the practice can help ease aches and pains and reduce stress: pain relief through practice, allowed under the new rule; it names no disease.
Registration on this page is handled by The Shift Network; the page itself is on her own site.
This brings her offerings to 10, the cap.
